<?php
define('MOD', 1000000007);

function power($b, $n) {
    $ans = 1;
    $b = $b % MOD;
    while ($n > 0) {
        if ($n % 2 == 1) {
            $ans = ($ans * $b) % MOD;
        }
        $n = intdiv($n, 2);
        $b = ($b * $b) % MOD;
    }
    return $ans;
}

function insert($p, &$num, &$cnt) {
    if ($num[$p] == 0) {
        $num[$p] = 1;
        $cnt[$p] = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    $p--;
    $limit = (int)sqrt($p);
    for ($i = 2; $i <= $limit; $i++) {
        if ($p % $i != 0) continue;
        $c = 0;
        while ($p % $i == 0) {
            $p = intdiv($p, $i);
            $c++;
        }
        if ($num[$i] < $c) {
            $num[$i] = $c;
            $cnt[$i] = 1;
        } else if ($num[$i] == $c) {
            $cnt[$i]++;
        }
    }
    if ($p != 1) {
        $c = 1;
        if ($num[$p] < $c) {
            $num[$p] = $c;
            $cnt[$p] = 1;
        } else if ($num[$p] == $c) {
            $cnt[$p]++;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

function check($x, &$num, &$cnt) {
    $limit = (int)sqrt($x);
    for ($i = 2; $i <= $limit; $i++) {
        if ($x % $i != 0) continue;
        $c = 0;
        while ($x % $i == 0) {
            $x = intdiv($x, $i);
            $c++;
        }
        if ($c == $num[$i] && $cnt[$i] == 1) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if ($x != 1 && $num[$x] == 1 && $cnt[$x] == 1) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

function main() {
    $input = trim(file_get_contents('php://stdin'));
    $tokens = explode(' ', $input);
    $idx = 0;
    $n = (int)$tokens[$idx++];
    $p = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
        $p[$i] = (int)$tokens[$idx++];
    }
    
    // Sort p[1..n] in descending order
    $slice = array_slice($p, 1, $n);
    rsort($slice);
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
        $p[$i] = $slice[$i - 1];
    }
    
    $M = 2000005;
    $num = array_fill(0, $M, 0);
    $cnt = array_fill(0, $M, 0);
    $a = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
    
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
        $a[$i] = $p[$i] - insert($p[$i], $num, $cnt);
    }
    
    $ans = 1;
    for ($i = 2; $i < $M; $i++) {
        $ans = ($ans * power($i, $num[$i])) % MOD;
    }
    
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
        if (check($a[$i], $num, $cnt)) {
            $ans = ($ans + 1) % MOD;
            break;
        }
    }
    
    echo $ans . "\n";
}

main();
?>

<?php
define('MOD', 1000000007);
define('N', 200005);
define('M', 2000005);

function power($b, $n) {
    $ans = 1;
    $b %= MOD;
    while ($n > 0) {
        if ($n % 2 == 1) {
            $ans = ($ans * $b) % MOD;
        }
        $b = ($b * $b) % MOD;
        $n = intdiv($n, 2);
    }
    return $ans;
}

function insert($p, &$num, &$cnt) {
    if ($num[$p] == 0) {
        $num[$p] = 1;
        $cnt[$p] = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    $p--;
    $limit = (int)sqrt($p);
    for ($i = 2; $i <= $limit; $i++) {
        if ($p % $i != 0) continue;
        $c = 0;
        while ($p % $i == 0) {
            $p = intdiv($p, $i);
            $c++;
        }
        if ($num[$i] < $c) {
            $num[$i] = $c;
            $cnt[$i] = 1;
        } else if ($num[$i] == $c) {
            $cnt[$i]++;
        }
    }
    if ($p != 1) {
        $c = 1;
        if ($num[$p] < $c) {
            $num[$p] = $c;
            $cnt[$p] = 1;
        } else if ($num[$p] == $c) {
            $cnt[$p]++;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

function check($x, $num, $cnt) {
    $limit = (int)sqrt($x);
    for ($i = 2; $i <= $limit; $i++) {
        if ($x % $i != 0) continue;
        $c = 0;
        while ($x % $i == 0) {
            $x = intdiv($x, $i);
            $c++;
        }
        if ($c == $num[$i] && $cnt[$i] == 1) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if ($x != 1 && $num[$x] == 1 && $cnt[$x] == 1) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// Read input
$input = trim(fgets(STDIN));
if ($input === false || $input === '') {
    return;
}
$n = (int)$input;
$p = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
    if ($line === false) $line = '';
    $p[$i] = (int)$line;
}

// Sort p[1..n] in descending order
$sorted_p = array_slice($p, 1, $n);
usort($sorted_p, function($a, $b) {
    return $b - $a;
});

$num = array_fill(0, M, 0);
$cnt = array_fill(0, M, 0);
$a = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);

for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $val = $sorted_p[$i - 1];
    $res = insert($val, $num, $cnt);
    $a[$i] = $val - $res;
}

$ans = 1;
for ($i = 2; $i < M - 1; $i++) {
    if ($num[$i] > 0) {
        $ans = ($ans * power($i, $num[$i])) % MOD;
    }
}

for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if (check($a[$i], $num, $cnt)) {
        $ans = ($ans + 1) % MOD;
        break;
    }
}

echo $ans . "\n";
?>

source_data.prob_desc_description: You are given a tuple generator $$$f^{(k)} = (f_1^{(k)}, f_2^{(k)}, \dots, f_n^{(k)})$$$, where $$$f_i^{(k)} = (a_i \cdot f_i^{(k - 1)} + b_i) \bmod p_i$$$ and $$$f^{(0)} = (x_1, x_2, \dots, x_n)$$$. Here $$$x \bmod y$$$ denotes the remainder of $$$x$$$ when divided by $$$y$$$. All $$$p_i$$$ are primes.One can see that with fixed sequences $$$x_i$$$, $$$y_i$$$, $$$a_i$$$ the tuples $$$f^{(k)}$$$ starting from some index will repeat tuples with smaller indices. Calculate the maximum number of different tuples (from all $$$f^{(k)}$$$ for $$$k \ge 0$$$) that can be produced by this generator, if $$$x_i$$$, $$$a_i$$$, $$$b_i$$$ are integers in the range $$$[0, p_i - 1]$$$ and can be chosen arbitrary. The answer can be large, so print the remainder it gives when divided by $$$10^9 + 7$$$
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print one integer — the maximum number of different tuples modulo $$$10^9 + 7$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of elements in the tuple. The second line contains $$$n$$$ space separated prime numbers — the modules $$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$ ($$$2 \le p_i \le 2 \cdot 10^6$$$).
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteIn the first example we can choose next parameters: $$$a = [1, 1, 1, 1]$$$, $$$b = [1, 1, 1, 1]$$$, $$$x = [0, 0, 0, 0]$$$, then $$$f_i^{(k)} = k \bmod p_i$$$.In the second example we can choose next parameters: $$$a = [1, 1, 2]$$$, $$$b = [1, 1, 0]$$$, $$$x = [0, 0, 1]$$$.
